us.judge_en: The compass places the US in Downtrend · Starved: price momentum is decelerating (z = -0.89) and the real mortgage-credit impulse is contracting at the same time (z = -0.55). Nominal prices are still rising 3.4% year-on-year, but on the full 50-year US cycle this is the weakest of the four cells, with a median forward-3-year gain of just 8.8% (n=62) versus 15-20% in the other three.
us.judge_zh: 羅盤把美國放在下行·斷炊：房價動能正在減速（z=-0.89），實質房貸信貸脈衝同時也在收縮（z=-0.55）。名目房價年增仍有3.4%，但放進美國完整50年週期來看，這是四個象限中最弱的一格，未來三年漲幅中位數僅8.8%（n=62），明顯低於其他三格的15%至20%。
us.warn_en: The supply-glut warning is on this quarter, triggered by the completions side — months-supply is loose (z = -1.84) even though homeowner vacancy itself is neutral (z = 0), meaning the excess sits in new construction still working through the pipeline rather than in existing empty homes.
us.warn_zh: 本季供給過剩警示為開，觸發點在完工端——月供給寬鬆（z=-1.84），儘管自住空置率本身持平（z=0），代表過剩集中在仍在興建管線中的新案，而非既有空屋。
us.card_val_en: Valuation is at its most expensive in the full 50-year record (z=−3.0) — price-to-income sits at the very top of its historical range.
us.card_val_zh: 估值處於整整 50 年紀錄中最貴的一端（z=−3.0）——房價對所得比落在歷史區間的最頂點。
us.card_pop_en: Population growth has turned negative (z = -0.87 on the absolute scale) — a reversal from the post-2020 immigration-driven surge, not just a slowdown relative to trend.
us.card_pop_zh: 人口成長轉為負值（絕對值尺度z=-0.87）——不只是相對趨勢走弱，而是從2020年後移民驅動的成長趨勢出現逆轉。
us.card_sup_en: Supply is loose near a historical extreme (z=−2.1) — months-supply of new homes is high across the full record, inventory building in the pipeline.
us.card_sup_zh: 供給寬鬆、逼近歷史極端（z=−2.1）——新屋月供給在整段紀錄中偏高，庫存正於管線中累積。
us.traj_en: The US moved from Fuelled through the 2020-22 pandemic boom into Draining as the Fed hiking cycle hit credit in 2022-23, dipped into Starved by late 2023, had a brief Draining rebound in mid-2024, and has sat in Starved since Q4 2024 — six straight quarters now.
us.traj_zh: 美國從2020年至2022年疫情熱潮期的有燃料，隨聯準會升息衝擊信貸轉入2022年至2023年的資金退，2023年底落入斷炊，2024年中曾短暫回到資金退，自2024年第4季起持續停留在斷炊，至今已連續六季。
us.xc_val_en: Ranked against the other 11 markets right now, the US is middling, not extreme: PTI of 12x ranks 5th, gross yield of 5.5% ranks 3rd, and the valuation composite comes out at +0.21 — barely on the cheap side of the world median. That's a sharp contrast with the self-history gauge above, which reads the US at its most expensive point in 50 years (z=-3.0): the same market looks stretched against its own past but only ordinary against the world.
us.xc_val_zh: 放進當下其他11個市場一起比較，美國的讀數其實並不極端：房價所得比12倍排名第5（中段），毛租金報酬率5.5%排名第3（相對強），估值綜合分數為+0.21，僅略偏世界中位數的便宜側。這與上方的自身歷史量表形成鮮明對比——那套量表把美國讀成50年紀錄中最貴的一端（z=-3.0）：同一個市場，相對自己的過去顯得緊繃，相對世界卻只是普通。
us.xc_carry_en: Carry spread is -1.3%, ranked 8th of 12 — the mortgage rate still runs ahead of the rental yield, so a levered US buyer is feeding the property every month rather than collecting income, betting the gap closes through price appreciation.
us.xc_carry_zh: 利差為-1.3%，在12個市場中排名第8——房貸利率仍高於租金報酬率，代表槓桿持有的美國買家每月都在倒貼、而不是收租金，賭的是房價後續上漲補回這個缺口。

tw.judge_en: Taiwan's compass currently reads downtrend / starved: price momentum (z=-1.742) and credit impulse (z=-1.273) are contracting together, and the -0.5% YoY price change confirms the market has actually turned down. Because Taiwan's usable history only runs back to 2001 and has been almost single-directional (mostly a bull run), treat this reading as a snapshot of the current state, not a forecast of what comes next.
tw.judge_zh: 台灣羅盤目前落在「下行·斷炊」象限：動能（z=-1.742）與信貸脈衝（z=-1.273）同步收縮，而現值年增率-0.5%也印證房價確實轉入下跌。由於台灣可用歷史僅自2001年起、且幾乎是單向多頭，這裡的讀數應理解為當下狀態的紀錄，而非對未來走勢的預測。
tw.warn_en: The supply-glut warning is ON for Taiwan, based on the low-electricity-usage vacancy proxy — a sizeable share of housing units show minimal electricity consumption, consistent with an elevated stock of unsold or unoccupied units.
tw.warn_zh: 台灣的供給過剩警示為「開啟」，依據為低用電量空屋率代理指標——相當比例的住宅單位用電量偏低，與未售或閒置存量偏高的狀況一致。
tw.card_val_en: Against Taiwan's own history the price-to-income ratio is mid-range (z≈0) — but that history is uniformly expensive: the ratio has sat near 9× for a decade. In absolute, cross-country terms Taiwan is among the least affordable markets anywhere; this gauge reads its own history, not that absolute.
tw.card_val_zh: 相對台灣自身歷史，房價所得比落在中段（z≈0）——但台灣的歷史本身就一路偏貴：此比值十年來都在 9 倍上下。就絕對、跨國水準而言，台灣是全世界最難負擔的市場之一；此量表讀的是台灣自己的歷史，不是那個絕對水準。
tw.card_pop_en: Population reads -0.62, negative — Taiwan's population is shrinking, a structural headwind for long-run housing demand.
tw.card_pop_zh: 人口讀數為-0.62，為負值——台灣人口正在萎縮，對長期房屋需求構成結構性逆風。
tw.card_sup_en: Supply is at its loosest on record (z=−2.5) — the low-electricity vacancy proxy shows an unusually large stock of empty units.
tw.card_sup_zh: 供給處於紀錄上最寬鬆（z=−2.5）——低度用電空屋代理指標顯示空置存量異常龐大。
tw.traj_en: Over the recent cycle Taiwan moved from fuelled (2019Q1-2022Q3) into draining (2022Q4-2024Q1), briefly returned to fuelled (2024Q2-2025Q1), passed through reflating (2025Q2), and has sat in starved since 2025Q3.
tw.traj_zh: 近期週期中，台灣先是處於「油門全開」（2019Q1至2022Q3），接著轉入「資金抽離」（2022Q4至2024Q1），短暫回到「油門全開」（2024Q2至2025Q1），經過「回溫」（2025Q2），並自2025Q3起持續落在「下行·斷炊」。
tw.xc_val_en: Vs the world right now, Taiwan is the most expensive of the four markets covered here: PTI of 16x ranks 10th of 12, gross yield of just 1.8% is dead last (12th), and the valuation composite of -0.94 is the worst reading in the set. That's the opposite conclusion from the self-history gauge, which reads Taiwan near-neutral (z≈0) — a decade of uniformly high prices simply hasn't left Taiwan's own history any cheap quarters to compare against. Measured against the world instead, the gap shows up in full.
tw.xc_val_zh: 放進世界一起排名，台灣是這四個市場中最貴的一個：房價所得比16倍排名第10，毛租金報酬率僅1.8%是12個市場中最差（第12），估值綜合分數-0.94也是這組數字裡最差的讀數。這與自身歷史量表的結論恰好相反——那套量表把台灣讀成接近中段（z≈0），原因是台灣過去十年價格本身就一路偏貴，自身歷史裡根本找不到便宜的季度可以比較。換成跟世界比，這個落差才完整顯現出來。
tw.xc_carry_en: Carry spread is -0.5%, ranked 4th — better than the US but still negative: rental income does not cover the mortgage, so holding still leans on further price gains rather than paid-in-full economics.
tw.xc_carry_zh: 利差為-0.5%，排名第4——比美國好一些，但仍是負值：租金收入無法覆蓋房貸，持有仍仰賴房價繼續上漲，而不是靠現金流打平。

my.judge_en: The compass reads downtrend-starved: price momentum is negative (z=-0.36) and credit impulse is negative too (z=-0.24), meaning prices are losing steam while credit growth cools alongside them. Malaysia is a "welded" market where nominal prices essentially never fall, so a starved reading doesn't show up as a decline but as an anaemic 1.7% YoY — the tailwind behind the 2023-25 run has faded.
my.judge_zh: 羅盤讀數為下行．斷炊：價格動能為負（z=-0.36），信貸脈衝同步為負（z=-0.24），代表房價正在失去動能，信貸擴張也同步降溫。馬來西亞是「焊死」型市場，名目房價幾乎不曾下跌，因此斷炊訊號不會表現為房價下跌，而是年增率放緩至僅1.7%——支撐2023至2025年那波上漲的動力已經消退。
my.warn_en: Supply-glut warning is ON: NAPIC overhang data shows completions and unsold/vacant stock running loose relative to this market's own history, which caps pricing power even while headline prices still hold in positive territory.
my.warn_zh: 供給過剩警訊為開啟：NAPIC餘屋數據顯示，相對於本身的歷史區間，完工量與未售出／空置庫存都偏鬆偏高，即便表面房價仍維持正成長，漲價空間已被壓抑。
my.card_val_en: Mid-range against Malaysia's own history (z≈0) — neither cheap nor stretched by its own standard.
my.card_val_zh: 相對馬來西亞自身歷史落在中段（z≈0）——以自身標準衡量，既不便宜也不緊繃。
my.card_pop_en: Population signal is flat (z=0) — currently neither a growth tailwind nor a shrinkage headwind.
my.card_pop_zh: 人口訊號持平（z=0）——目前既非成長順風，也非萎縮逆風。
my.card_sup_en: Supply is loose (z=−1.2) — NAPIC's unsold overhang sits high in Malaysia's own history.
my.card_sup_zh: 供給寬鬆（z=−1.2）——NAPIC 未售餘屋在馬來西亞自身歷史中偏高。
my.traj_en: Malaysia moved from starved (2021Q2-2022Q2) into a draining phase where prices still rose but credit tightened (2022Q3-2023Q3), then a fully fuelled rally (2023Q4-2025Q3), briefly touched reflating in 2025Q4, and has fallen back to starved as of 2026Q1.
my.traj_zh: 馬來西亞的走勢先是斷炊期（2021Q2至2022Q2），轉入房價仍漲、但信貸轉緊的失血期（2022Q3至2023Q3），接著進入全力上漲的旺漲期（2023Q4至2025Q3），2025Q4短暫回溫，到2026Q1又落回斷炊。
my.xc_val_en: Malaysia ranks well on both valuation inputs: PTI of 11x is the 4th-cheapest of 12 markets and gross yield of 5.2% is the 4th-highest, combining into the best valuation composite in the set at +0.57. Unlike the US or Taiwan, there's no split verdict here — Malaysia reads reasonably priced against both its own history (z≈0) and the world.
my.xc_val_zh: 馬來西亞在兩項估值指標上都排名靠前：房價所得比11倍是12個市場中第4便宜，毛租金報酬率5.2%是第4高，兩者合成出這組數字裡最好的估值綜合分數，+0.57。與美國或台灣不同，這裡沒有出現分歧的結論——馬來西亞相對自身歷史（z≈0）與相對世界，讀數都算合理。
my.xc_carry_en: Carry spread is positive at +0.9%, ranked 3rd of 12 — rental income clears the mortgage rate with room to spare, so a Malaysian property is closer to paying for itself than feeding the owner each month. The one weak spot in the picture is vacancy at 15%, ranked 11th of 12 — plenty of empty stock competing for that rent.
my.xc_carry_zh: 利差為正值+0.9%，在12個市場中排名第3——租金收入足以覆蓋房貸利率並留有餘裕，代表馬來西亞的房產比較接近自己養活自己，而不是每月倒貼。畫面裡唯一的弱點是空置率15%，排名第11——有不少空置存量在跟這份租金競爭。

jp.judge_en: Japan's compass reads Uptrend·Draining: house prices are still rising (momentum z=+0.44, YoY at 5%), but the credit impulse behind them is contracting sharply (z=-2.36). That combination — rising prices without expanding credit — has historically been fragile: draining-cell quarters carry a median forward-3y return of -2.3% (n=38), well below fuelled uptrends' +6%. For a market that already lived through a real bubble and a 14-year crash (1991 peak to 2005), a credit-starved rally is not a state to get comfortable in.
jp.judge_zh: 日本羅盤讀數為「上行·資金退」：房價仍在上漲（動能 z=+0.44，年增率5%），但背後的信貸動能正劇烈萎縮（z=-2.36）。這種「價格上漲、信貸卻不擴張」的組合，過去表現偏脆弱：資金退象限的季度，未來三年報酬中位數為-2.3%（n=38），遠低於有燃料上行的+6%。對這個曾經歷過真正泡沫、並崩跌長達十四年（1991年見頂至2005年）的市場而言，一段缺乏信貸支撐的漲勢並非可以安心的狀態。
jp.warn_en: The supply-glut warning is on: Japan's 空き家率 (vacancy rate) reading is at an extreme (vacancy z=-2.7), reflecting the country's large and growing stock of empty homes — a structural overhang sitting underneath whatever near-term price momentum shows up.
jp.warn_zh: 供給過剩警示已觸發：日本的「空き家率」（空屋率）讀數處於極端水準（空置率 z=-2.7），反映出全國龐大且持續增加的空屋存量——這是壓在任何短期房價動能之下的結構性過剩。
jp.card_val_en: Slightly below its own historical middle (z=+0.2) — but only because the 1991 bubble tops the record; in absolute terms Japanese housing relative to income is still high.
jp.card_val_zh: 略低於自身歷史中位（z=+0.2）——但這只因為 1991 年泡沫佔據紀錄頂點；就絕對水準而言，日本房價相對所得仍偏高。
jp.card_pop_en: Population reads -0.74, confirming Japan's demographic reality: the population is shrinking rather than growing, which erodes structural housing demand over time.
jp.card_pop_zh: 人口讀數為-0.74，印證了日本的人口現實：人口正在萎縮而非成長，長期將侵蝕房屋的結構性需求。
jp.card_sup_en: Supply is moderately loose (z=−0.8) — the 空き家率 vacancy rate is elevated, a large empty-home stock, though new completions have thinned.
jp.card_sup_zh: 供給中度寬鬆（z=−0.8）——空き家率偏高，龐大的空屋存量，不過新完工量已變薄。
jp.traj_en: Since 2019, Japan's compass moved from reflating (2019Q3-2021Q1) into a fuelled uptrend (2021Q2-2022Q1), then slid into draining (2022Q2-2023Q4), briefly touched starved in 2024Q1, and has sat in draining again from 2024Q2 through 2025Q4 — a rally that keeps losing its credit support.
jp.traj_zh: 自2019年起，日本的羅盤讀數從資金回流（2019Q3至2021Q1）轉入有燃料的上行（2021Q2至2022Q1），接著滑入資金退（2022Q2至2023Q4），2024Q1一度觸及斷炊，並自2024Q2到2025Q4再度停留在資金退——一段不斷失去信貸支撐的漲勢。
jp.xc_val_en: Japan's valuation composite is +0.24, close to the US's +0.21 but reached differently: PTI of 15x ranks 8th (unremarkable) while yield of 4.3% ranks 7th — a middling combination, not a standout-cheap market. Against its own history the price-to-income ratio also reads only slightly below its 1991-bubble-skewed middle (z=+0.2); on both frames Japan is ordinary on price — that's not the story here.
jp.xc_val_zh: 日本的估值綜合分數為+0.24，跟美國的+0.21相近，但成因不同：房價所得比15倍排名第8（不算突出），租金報酬率4.3%排名第7——是一個中段的組合，並非特別便宜的市場。相對自身歷史，房價所得比也只是略低於被1991年泡沫拉高的中位數（z=+0.2）；不論哪個座標，日本在價格這件事上都偏普通，這不是它的故事重點。
jp.xc_carry_en: Carry spread is +2.5%, ranked 2nd of 12 and the best in the set on this measure — ultra-low mortgage rates mean rent covers financing with the widest margin of any market here. The catch is on the other side of the ledger: population growth is -0.5%, the worst of all 12 markets, so the demand base funding that rent is shrinking.
jp.xc_carry_zh: 利差為+2.5%，在12個市場中排名第2，是這組數字裡最好的讀數——超低房貸利率讓租金能以最大的餘裕覆蓋融資成本。問題出在天秤的另一端：人口成長率為-0.5%，是全部12個市場中最差的一個，代表撐起這份租金的需求基礎正在萎縮。

method.lede_en: A house market asks two questions that one number can't answer at once — where prices are headed, and whether the market is healthy. This page keeps them on separate instruments. The Compass forecasts direction from the only force that predicts consistently across markets: momentum, the market's own recent price trend, paired with the credit that fuels or starves it. The Report Card diagnoses condition — valuation, population, supply — as separate gauges that describe health without pretending to time it. Two jobs, two tools, never blended into a single score.
method.lede_zh: 一個房市同時問兩個問題，而一個數字無法一次回答——價格接下來往哪走，以及這個市場健不健康。這頁把兩者放在不同的儀器上。羅盤只用一種在各市場都穩定有預測力的力量來判斷方向：動能，也就是房價自身近期的走勢，再配上為它添柴或斷炊的信貸。健檢卡則診斷體質——估值、人口、供給——用各自獨立的量表描述健康，而不假裝能拿它來抓時機。兩種工作、兩套工具，絕不合併成單一分數。
method.why_en: The split isn't a stylistic choice — it's what the data forces. Test each force on its own against three-year forward house-price returns across the US, Taiwan, Malaysia and Japan, and momentum is the only one that works everywhere: quarters following price uptrends beat quarters following downtrends by 7 to 14 points, in every market, no exceptions. Valuation fails the same test — it mean-reverts the way textbooks promise in cyclical markets, but in Japan it reversed by 18.9 points, because post-1990 cheapness there was structural decay, not a bargain waiting to close. That is exactly why valuation can't sit on the forecast axis: it describes condition, and condition points in different directions in different markets. Blend it into one “cycle” score and you answer two questions at once — where prices go next, and whether the market is expensive — and get both muddy. Kept apart, each instrument can be judged on its own terms. The Compass's four-cell ordering — Fuelled beating Starved — holds in the US, Malaysia and Japan; it breaks in Taiwan, but that's a sample problem, not a method one: 101 quarters of a nearly one-directional bull run means almost every “downtrend” quarter was simply followed by the next leg up. Momentum is also what finally reads Japan right — the one market that had a real crash to get right.
method.why_zh: 這樣拆開不是風格選擇，是資料逼出來的結果。把每一種力量單獨拿去對美國、台灣、馬來西亞、日本的三年前向房價報酬做檢驗，動能是唯一在所有市場都有效的一項：房價處於上升趨勢之後的季度，報酬比處於下降趨勢之後的季度高出七至十四個百分點，四個市場、無一例外。估值撐不過同一套檢驗——在有循環性的市場裡它照教科書均值回歸，但在日本反轉了十八點九個百分點，因為 1990 年後的便宜是結構性衰敗，不是等待兌現的划算。這正是估值不能放上預測軸的原因：它描述的是體質，而體質在不同市場指向不同方向。把它攪進一個「週期」分數，等於同時回答兩個問題——價格接下來往哪走、以及市場貴不貴——結果兩個都答得含糊。拆開來，每套儀器才能各自被檢驗。羅盤的四格排序——燃料格贏過飢餓格——在美國、馬來西亞、日本都成立；在台灣不成立，但這是樣本問題，不是方法問題：一百零一季幾乎單向的多頭，意味著「下降趨勢」的季度後面幾乎都接著下一段漲勢。也是動能，終於讓日本這個唯一真正崩盤過的市場被讀對。
method.frames_en: Three reference frames sit on this page, and each answers a different question. The compass is trailing and cyclical — momentum and credit impulse — and answers where prices are likely headed next. The self-history gauges are expanding, measuring valuation, population and supply against a market's own multi-decade record, and answer whether the market looks strained relative to its own past. The cross-country ranks are neither: they measure a market against the other 11 right now, and answer whether it's actually cheap or expensive in absolute terms. The US and Taiwan show why one frame alone misleads — the US reads expensive against its own history (z=-3.0) but only middling against the world (composite +0.21), while Taiwan reads neutral against its own history (z≈0) yet is the most expensive of the four against the world (composite -0.94, worst yield of all 12 markets). Use all three together, not one in isolation.
method.frames_zh: 這個頁面有三個參照座標，各自回答不同問題。羅盤是落後、順週期的——動能與信貸脈衝——回答「價格接下來可能往哪走」。健檢卡的自身歷史量表是擴張型的，把估值、人口與供給拿去對比該市場自己數十年的紀錄，回答「相對自己的過去，這個市場現在算不算緊繃」。跨國排名則兩者皆非：它把一個市場放進當下其他11個市場中比較，回答「就絕對水準而言，這個市場到底貴不貴」。美國與台灣正好說明只用單一座標會誤導：美國相對自身歷史顯得昂貴（z=-3.0），但相對世界卻只是中段（綜合分數+0.21）；台灣相對自身歷史持平（z≈0），但相對世界卻是這四個市場中最貴的一個（綜合分數-0.94，租金報酬率為全部12個市場中最差）。三者要合起來看，不能只取其一。

howto.compass_howto_en: The horizontal axis is momentum — the recent trend in house prices; the vertical axis is credit impulse — whether mortgage and household credit is accelerating or slowing. Crossing them gives four cells: Uptrend·Fuelled (prices rising, credit accelerating), Uptrend·Draining (prices rising but credit fading), Downtrend·Reflating (prices falling but credit turning up), and Downtrend·Starved (prices falling, credit still tightening). The glowing dot marks the latest quarter; a supply-glut warning lights up separately whenever vacancy or completions hit an extreme, since a glut can make even a fuelled uptrend risky.
howto.compass_howto_zh: 橫軸是動能——房價近期的趨勢；縱軸是信貸脈衝——房貸與家庭信貸正在加速還是放緩。兩軸交叉出四格：上升·助燃（房價漲、信貸加速）、上升·抽乾（房價漲但信貸轉弱）、下降·回溫（房價跌但信貸開始回升）、下降·斷糧（房價跌、信貸仍在收緊）。發光的點是最新一季；供給過剩警示會另外亮起——只要空置率或完工量觸及極端值，即使是助燃中的上升格也可能變得危險。
howto.card_howto_en: Valuation, population growth and supply sit here as separate, transparent gauges — each one shows only whether that single force looks strained or comfortable right now. They are deliberately never averaged into one score and never used to predict where prices go next; that job belongs to the compass. Each gauge is standardised over the market's whole history, so it reads position versus that market's own past — not a cross-country absolute (a market that is always expensive, like Taiwan near 9× income, reads mid-range against itself).
howto.card_howto_zh: 估值、人口成長與供給在這裡各是一個獨立、透明的儀表——每一個只顯示該力量目前偏緊繃還是偏寬鬆，僅此而已。它們刻意不被平均成一個分數，也不用來預測房價接下來會怎麼走；那是羅盤的工作。 每個量表以該市場整段歷史標準化，讀的是相對該市場自身過去的位置——不是跨國絕對值（一個一直很貴的市場，如台灣約 9 倍所得，相對自己會落在中段）。
howto.fwd_note_en: In the US, Malaysia and Japan, the four compass cells order from best to worst forward three-year returns roughly as labelled — Fuelled beats Starved. Taiwan's history is too short and one-sided (about 101 quarters, almost all inside one bull run) for that ordering to hold — every "downtrend" quarter there was simply followed by the next leg up — so treat the forward numbers as a description of the past, not a promise.
howto.fwd_note_zh: 在美國、馬來西亞與日本，羅盤四格的前向三年報酬大致依標籤排序由好到壞——助燃格贏過斷糧格。台灣的歷史太短、又幾乎單向（約 101 季，幾乎全落在同一段多頭），這個排序在那裡不成立——每一個「下降」的季度，後面接的都是下一段漲勢——因此前向數字請當作對過去的描述，不是承諾。
howto.xc_howto_en: This panel adds a third yardstick: instead of a market's own past, it ranks each market against the other 11 in the world right now — on PTI, rental yield, carry spread, vacancy and population growth — plus a combined valuation composite. Rank 1 means the most attractive reading of the 12; a market can look ordinary against its own history and still be cheap (or expensive) against the world, or the reverse.
howto.xc_howto_zh: 此面板加入第三個座標：不再只看一個市場相對自己過去的位置，而是把它放進當下的12個市場中排名——涵蓋房價所得比、租金報酬率、利差、空置率與人口成長，並合成一個估值綜合分數。第1名代表12個市場中最具吸引力的讀數；一個市場可能相對自身歷史普通，但相對世界卻便宜（或昂貴），反之亦然。
